title: The Difference (after Sturtevant)
summary: Two identical Pop flowers stacked in difference-blend cancel to black, so a perfect copy shows nothing and only your misregistration is visible.
mechanism: Canvas globalCompositeOperation='difference' subtracts a draggable copy from its identical original, with a live getImageData pixel count reporting fidelity vs. visible art.
references: Walter Benjamin, The Work of Art in the Age of Mechanical Reproduction (1935)
